description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendments, Kiribathkumbura, Yatinuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320552
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific changes to land ownership records, property boundaries, ownership status changes (e.g., from "State" to "Private" or "Road Development Authority"), and corrections to land extent measurements. The content is focused entirely on land and property matters, falling clearly under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership changes, and title amendments.
